svg.text: All In Capital · Application Triage, With AI (built system)
Loop 1 screens each application up to Kushal's sign off. Loop 2 runs outreach up to the call. People decide every outcome. Dashed boxes and lines marked v2 are planned (PRD Section 24).

ALWAYS ON · the never-fail checks, under both loops

N1 no funded company marked PASS with no flag · N2 every citation exists · N3 a founder-only claim is never shown as confirmed · N4 only Riya's click sends an email · N5 no application vanishes · N6 no founder name, email or phone reaches a model · text aimed at the AI is ignored · daily cost cap pauses at a saved step, then resumes
v2 adds: Portkey with 1, 2, 4 second retries · answer cache · a separate test database · cap alert by email · model inputs cleared after 30 days · consent line on the form

Upload, cheap checks, two tracks of evidence, scores, brief. Ends at Gate 2.
Draft, Riya sends, read the reply, book or offer new slots. Ends at the call.

Riya's rule corrections come back as context for similar companies.
What Riya changes in a draft shapes the next draft.
LOOPS E · F · Follow up, slots
No reply: follow up on day 3 and 7. New time: new slots, two rounds, then Riya.
Was the call worth 30 minutes? Outcomes join the next back test.
Kushal sends an application back to Riya. A portfolio conflict holds it: no email.

Riya's overrides and email edits, by week. Spikes are read with the evals.
